description: operation_mode=MoistCooling, set by Kevin directly via the app (not our CLI) -- matches 'Moist air conditioning (cooling)' from the app's mode list he shared earlier. Confirms this mode behaves like Cooling/CoolDehumidifying (real settable target temperature) rather than ComfortableDehumidification (humidity target, temperature forced to 0.0).
app_confirmed: Kevin set this himself via the app; confirmed a real target-temperature control (range 16-30C in the app) and manual louver/wind_direction_horizon controls -- both consistent with this being a 'cooling-family' mode, not a 'humidity-target' mode like Dry.
notes: CONFIRMED: EoliaOperationMode.MOIST_COOLING behaves like Cooling/CoolDehumidifying: real temperature target (not forced to 0.0 like ComfortableDehumidification), and normal wind_direction/wind_direction_horizon fixed-position controls (not reset to auto the way KeepMode resets them). Supports climate.py's existing HVACMode.COOL bucket assignment for this mode.
App's stated temperature range for this mode is 16-30C -- consistent with what a normal AC temperature range should be, though not yet tested at either boundary live.
ai_control=off here, drifted/reset from whatever it was before (not tested whether this mode forces ai_control off, or whether Kevin set it manually while switching modes in the app).
